items.name: cn
items.title: cn() class merge helper
items.description: clsx + tailwind-merge. Required by every component; installed automatically as a dependency.

items.name: motion
items.title: motion presets
items.description: The springs the library moves with, in one place; a hook that drops them when the reader asked for less motion; and the timing helpers that sample a spring into a `linear()` curve, so a glide runs in the browser instead of in a callback. Required by Tabs, Collapsible and Transition; installed automatically as a dependency.

items.name: measure
items.title: measure helpers
items.description: Two numbers a glide cannot be written without: the box's padding and borders, and the screen-per-CSS-pixel scale an ancestor transform or a CSS zoom puts on a measurement. Required by Transition and Tabs; installed automatically as a dependency.

items.name: control
items.title: control idioms
items.description: The five things every control in the library looks the same way: the tint a hover or a press leaves, the size an icon slot takes from the text around it, the shell of a text field, the box a tick or a dot is drawn in, and the row a list of choices is made of. Required by Button, Input, Textarea, Checkbox, RadioGroup, Collapsible, Menu, Select, Nav and Steps; installed automatically as a dependency.

items.name: surface
items.title: overlay surfaces
items.description: What every floating surface shares: the layer ladder (a backdrop, a popup, a tooltip, a toast), the scrim, the way a popup arrives, the box its positioner is measured in, the viewport that slides one panel to the next, and the arrow that points back at its trigger. Required by Dialog, Drawer, Popover, Tooltip and Menu; installed automatically as a dependency.

items.name: clipboard
items.title: useCopy
items.description: A copy button's two halves — the write, and the moment of 'copied' that says it landed — so every copy in the library forgets at the same speed and none of them claims a copy the clipboard refused.

items.name: theme
items.title: lumo-ui theme tokens
items.description: Semantic CSS variables (shadcn-compatible names), the derived radius scale, dark mode variant and base layer. Skip this if the target project already defines these variables.

items.name: shiki
items.title: shiki highlighter
items.description: The highlighter behind Code and CodeDiff: one shared core, a grammar per file fetched on demand, a light/dark colour pair per token so the theme can flip without re-tokenising, and a cache so the same snippet is tokenised once however many blocks show it.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: Default loading indicator: a container-query sized ring of pulsing dots, one em across so it matches the icon it replaces. Cancel the status role where the surrounding control already announces its own state.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The reference component: tailwind-variants API, token-driven appearance, data-slot / data-variant hooks.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: One surface for one subject: a header with its title, description and action, a body that takes the slack, and a footer. Two sizes, set once on the root and read by every part, and a `hoverable` root for a card that is a target.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Hover and focus hint anchored to its trigger. Behaviour from Base UI, appearance from tokens.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A select whose options are found by typing: the field is the control, so the chosen label stays in it and the query narrows the list under it. A caret opens the list without typing, a clear button appears only while there is something to clear, and the rows are the same rows Menu and Select draw. Behaviour from Base UI, appearance from tokens.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog. Behaviour from Base UI, appearance from tokens.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Disclosure region that expands and collapses one panel. Its height belongs to Transition, so a fold is one box on the one size spring rather than two animations of the same edge. Behaviour from Base UI, appearance from tokens.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Anchored panel that holds rich content. One popup can be shared by several detached triggers, each with its own payload. Behaviour from Base UI, appearance from tokens.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: A menu of actions on a trigger: groups, a group label, separators, and one popup several detached triggers can share. Behaviour from Base UI, appearance from tokens.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A line between two regions, horizontal or vertical, announced as a separator. Behaviour from Base UI, appearance from tokens.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: A sequence of steps as an ordered list: one current index makes the items before it finish and the ones after wait, and the connector is drawn by the item so the spacing is never placed by hand.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: One panel at a time, chosen from a row of tabs, with a highlight that travels between them — stacked and cross-fading, or all of them side by side on a track that is slid to the selected one. The track and the box under it move on springs, written to the DOM rather than to state, so a tab change does not re-render the panels it is switching between. Behaviour from Base UI, appearance from tokens.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A panel that slides in from an edge and can be swiped away. Each of the four edges is one swipe direction. Behaviour from Base UI, appearance from tokens.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholder for content that has not arrived. Give it the size the real content will be.

items.name: nav
items.title: Nav
items.description: A list of navigation rows: groups, icons, active state, badges, inline sub rows, and a compact rail where a row with children opens them in a popover. The nav knows nothing about the shell it sits in — width, position and scrolling are the caller’s.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: ScrollArea
items.description: A pane that scrolls under the platform's overlay bar: instead of the box's own, a track drawn over the content that stays out of sight until the pane is scrolled or pointed at. Behaviour from Base UI, appearance from tokens.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: One value out of many, in a list laid under the control that opened it: an Input's shell as a trigger with a caret that turns itself, a row shared with Menu whose chosen line is filled rather than checked, and scroll arrows at the ends of a long list. The popup opens under the trigger rather than over it. Behaviour from Base UI, appearance from tokens.

items.name: layout
items.title: Layout
items.description: The app shell: a rail drawn from a nav array, and the surface a page scrolls in. Variant `default` insets that surface as a card on every edge; `plain` lets the page run edge to edge. Each page keeps its own header.

items.name: code
items.title: Code
items.description: A block of source: a header naming the file or language, a copy button, optional line numbers, and shiki highlighting whose grammars load only when a block needs them. An unknown language falls back to plain text instead of failing.

items.name: code-diff
items.title: CodeDiff
items.description: Two revisions of one file, side by side or stacked, with both line numberings, a per-side change stripe and the additions and deletions counted in the header. Shares Code's header, copy button and highlighting.

items.name: code-tree
items.title: CodeTree
items.description: A flat list of paths drawn as the tree a person reads a project in: folders that open and close, one file active. The rows are Nav — hover, active fill, caret and focus come from there — so the tree only supplies the shape and the glyph each file is drawn with.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Transient messages in a corner stack: behaviour from Base UI, appearance from tokens, and a Toaster that maps the queue to parts so a caller only ever queues a toast.

items.name: transition
items.title: Transition
items.description: A box that keeps its size to what is inside it and glides to each new one — continuously, so a reflow, a late font or a swap does not move the page beneath it. The glide is a spring handed to the browser, and an interruption carries the speed it already had. Give it a `height` and it holds that instead, which is how a fold stays closed. Measured: no fade, no travel, no second copy of the text.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: One control, its name, and the line beneath it: label, description and error joined to whatever control is inside, by Base UI's own wiring. Pairs with Input, and every later control slots into it.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A single line of text in the same 32 / 36 / 40 tiers a Button takes, so the two line up. Registers itself with a surrounding Field and reads the invalid border off it.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: One of several, any number of them: a 16px box, the tick inside it, and a real hidden input so a form and a label both see a checkbox. Indeterminate draws a dash in place of the tick.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: Exactly one of these, and never none: Base UI's group and its radio as one namespace, so the value, the arrow keys and the dot between them arrive together.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A track and a knob, on or off, in the space of one line of text. Two spans, no glyph, and a flag Base UI writes on both of them.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Several lines of text in the same box as an Input. The element is the browser's, mounted through Field.Control, which is what gives it a name, a describedby and the invalid border inside a field.
